subject.title: Crons ejecutaron mensajes de WhatsApp a la 1 AM fuera de horario y no se podían detener

question: Should this issue close after the schedule-activation replay fix lands with emergency stop/delete tracked separately, or should one combined change define cron remove and gateway stop as emergency outbound-delivery controls?
rationale: The replay bug has a concrete candidate fix, but the remaining requested behavior changes user-visible operator semantics across cron, task cancellation, gateway lifecycle, and channel delivery.

options.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
options.body: Use the existing replay PR or an equivalent replacement for the restart misfire, then sponsor a separate design for emergency outbound halt semantics.

options.title: Require One Combined Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open until a single implementation covers restart replay, cron remove cancellation, and gateway emergency outbound halt behavior.

options.title: Narrow To Replay Only
options.body: Treat stop/delete and emergency halt as out of scope for this issue and close only after the replay fix lands.

recommendation.title: Land Replay Fix, Split Emergency Stop
recommendation.body: Use the existing replay PR or an equivalent replacement for the restart misfire, then sponsor a separate design for emergency outbound halt semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent direct history on the candidate schedule-activation migration and posted maintainer verification for the active PR.
